ارتكسنا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَكَسْنَا (irtakasnā) /ir.ta.kas.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
# اُرْتُكِسْنَا (urtukisnā) /ur.tu.kis.naː/: first-person plural past passive of اِرْتَكَسَ (irtakasa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
